description: Hello! My name is Shahd Ayman, and I am in the 9th grade. I study at Al Manara Private School in Sharjah. I am a curious and passionate student who loves exploring new things, discovering the mysteries of space, and working hard to achieve my dreams.
summary: This project explores the equipment NASA has left behind in space since the 1960s. It introduces important spacecraft, rovers, and scientific instruments that have helped scientists discover more about our solar system. It focuses on the Apollo missions on the Moon, the Curiosity and Perseverance rovers on Mars, and Voyager 1 and Voyager 2 in deep space. The project explains their purposes, scientific achievements, and current conditions. Some of these machines have stopped working, while others are still exploring. Through this project, we aim to show how these machines have contributed to space science and helped humanity understand the universe. details:
Our project is an educational video about the equipment NASA has left behind in space since the 1960s. It explains how spacecraft, rovers, and scientific instruments work and what they have helped scientists discover.

The project highlights the Apollo missions on the Moon, Curiosity and Perseverance on Mars, and Voyager 1 and Voyager 2 in deep space.

The main benefit is helping students understand space exploration and the importance of these machines in scientific discoveries. Our goal is to inspire young people to learn more about space and science.

We created the project using AI tools for video creation, voice generation, and editing. We also used research and creative storytelling to present scientific information in an interesting way.

Our creativity comes from combining animation, narration, and scientific facts to make the project engaging and educational. We considered accuracy, clarity, creativity, and the needs of school-age viewers.
